items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: That's when we had Oscar Marco and his brother, Mickey Marco.

ctx.x: Did many of the dance bands have violins in them, most of them?

No, no dance bands. No violins at all. They didn't do it? All the dance bands that they had was just reed, brass, and string. I mean, it falls to bass, what do you call it? Yeah. But I mean, they didn't have the... But there was no such thing as violins or nothing. The first band that I played were a dance band that had a violin. That's when I tell you that I played at the Black Orchard, whose name the Black Orchard was Pete Hoyman's place. That's when we had Oscar Marco and his brother, Mickey Marco. You see?…
But back in Jack Lane's days, he didn't use a violin... Well, yeah.
